dedupe_keys.name: uruguay national rural and urban cadastral parcel shapefiles dnc

description: Dirección Nacional de Catastro (DNC), Uruguay publishes shapefiles of the national cadastral parcel fabric of Uruguay: four downloads named on the portal as the whole country urban parcels, rural parcels, cadastral sections and localities. Coverage: the whole of Uruguay; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-09. Format and access: Shapefile, downloadable without registration from the Uruguay national open data catalogue; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licencia de DAG de Uruguay; cost: free. Caveats: the shapefiles were not opened, so attribute fields, parcel counts and any ownership or land-use columns are unconfirmed; the layer is a parcel geometry, not a building footprint. Simulation uses: parcel-level exposure joins for flood and coastal hazard layers, land-use and urban growth models, and as the spatial base for asset registers. Related catalogue records: Montevideo cadastral parcels with land-use plan attributes (building heights, setbacks, occupation factors) (data-montevideo-cadastral-parcels-land-use-plan); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
